rss.title: Who Survives The Zombie? Discipline vs Madness vs Obsession #shorts
rss.description:
Three fighters. One zombie each. Three very different ideas of what it takes to win.

Madness goes in bare-knuckle. Obsession keeps swinging his axe, even after the zombie drops. Discipline waits behind his shield for the right moment to bring his sword down.

Watch what each victory costs. Which fighter are you?

rss.title: 3 Mindsets vs Their Own Shadow. Which One Would You Choose? #shorts
rss.description:
Three mindsets fight against their own shadow. It moves half a second after them.

Madness wins by making it a war. Arms gone, dragging itself on the floor, at the price of its own health.

Obsession wins by not stopping or giving up. Attacking no matter the cost.

Discipline keeps his cool and attacks in rhythm. Only suffering minor injuries.

Which one pays the greatest price? And which one are you closest to? 👇

rss.title: 4 Mindsets Dig For Diamonds. Which One Are You? #shorts
rss.description:
Four mindsets dig for diamonds.

Motivation starts fast, fades, and quits one swing away.
Obsession breaks its pick, digs bloody, and grabs its diamond.
Discipline keeps one steady pace, never stops, and earns it.
Madness breaks its pick, digs with bare fists, walks straight past the diamonds… and finds a harder wall.

It was never about the diamonds.

Which one are you? 👇
